metadata.name: Locations
metadata.description: Organize your business by branch: each sales point and physical location, with its address and a default warehouse for its sales, shared by point of sale, customers and inventory.
metadata.author: Asteby
features: Register each branch as a sales point and physical location under your company.
Keep the address, phone and tax details of every branch.
Choose a default warehouse for the stock movements of each branch's sales.
Mark branches active or inactive without losing their history.
Point of sale, customers and inventory work against the branch you pick.
Prepare each branch for the online store: map location, opening hours, contact and in-store pickup, hidden until you turn it on.
A default branch named Sucursal Principal is created when you install.
Assign users to the branches they work at; people with no assignment keep seeing every branch.

es.name: Sucursales
es.description: Organiza tu negocio por sucursal: cada punto de venta y ubicación física con su dirección y un almacén por defecto para sus ventas, compartidas por punto de venta, clientes e inventario.
features: Registra cada sucursal como punto de venta y ubicación física de tu empresa.
Guarda la dirección, el teléfono y los datos fiscales de cada sucursal.
Elige un almacén por defecto para los movimientos de inventario de las ventas de cada sucursal.
Marca sucursales como activas o inactivas sin perder su historial.
El punto de venta, los clientes y el inventario trabajan sobre la sucursal que elijas.
Prepara cada sucursal para la tienda en línea: ubicación en el mapa, horario, contacto y recolección en sucursal, oculta hasta que la actives.
Al instalar se crea una sucursal predeterminada llamada Sucursal Principal.
Asigna usuarios a las sucursales donde trabajan; quien no tiene asignación sigue viendo todas las sucursales.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: Branch type. NULL is read as 'store'.
columns.label: locations.field.kind

columns.name: lat
columns.comment: Latitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Must be set together with lng; (0,0) is rejected.
columns.label: locations.field.lat

columns.name: lng
columns.comment: Longitude in decimal degrees (WGS84). Must be set together with lat; (0,0) is rejected.
columns.label: locations.field.lng

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: IANA timezone, e.g. America/Mexico_City. Opening hours are read in this zone.
columns.label: locations.field.timezone

columns.name: opening_hours
columns.comment: {weekly:[{day:1..7 (1=Mon),open:'HH:MM',close:'HH:MM'}], exceptions:[{date:'YYYY-MM-DD',closed?:bool,open?:'HH:MM',close?:'HH:MM',note?:text}]}. Shape enforced by a CHECK constraint (object, weekly/exceptions arrays).
columns.label: locations.field.opening_hours

columns.name: services
columns.comment: JSON array of free-text service labels offered at the branch (e.g. ["pickup","installation"]).
columns.label: locations.field.services

columns.name: whatsapp
columns.comment: WhatsApp number in international format.
columns.label: locations.field.whatsapp

columns.name: maps_url
columns.comment: Public map link (Google Maps, Apple Maps, OSM).
columns.label: locations.field.maps_url

columns.name: storefront_visible
columns.comment: Opt-in: only branches with true are exposed to the storefront. NULL is read as false.
columns.label: locations.field.storefront_visible

columns.name: pickup_enabled
columns.comment: The branch accepts in-store pickup orders. NULL is read as false.
columns.label: locations.field.pickup_enabled

columns.name: pickup_fee
columns.comment: Pickup fee. NULL means free pickup.
columns.label: locations.field.pickup_fee

columns.name: pickup_prep_days_min
columns.comment: Minimum days to have a pickup order ready.
columns.label: locations.field.pickup_prep_days_min

columns.name: pickup_prep_days_max
columns.comment: Maximum days to have a pickup order ready.
columns.label: locations.field.pickup_prep_days_max

columns.name: ships_from
columns.comment: The branch can be the origin of shipments. NULL is read as false.
columns.label: locations.field.ships_from

columns.name: position
columns.comment: Sort order in storefront listings (ascending).
columns.label: locations.field.position

columns.name: market_code
columns.label: locations.field.market_code
columns.comment: Code of the organization market (org_markets.code: mx, us...) this branch sells in. Empty = not tied to a market. Orders from the storefront are created in the branch of their market.

columns.name: entity_id
columns.label: locations.field.entity_id
columns.comment: Legal entity (razon social) this branch belongs to. Filled with the organization default entity when empty, so organizations that never configure entities behave as before.

columns.name: branch_type
columns.label: locations.field.branch_type
columns.comment: What the branch is. physical = a local with address and hours; channel = a virtual branch of a sales channel (Mercado Libre, Amazon, online store) that gives its orders an entity, series and issuer, with no local and no pickup; virtual_warehouse = groups stock without a local and does not sell. Independent from kind (store, service_center...).

columns.name: channel_account_ref
columns.label: locations.field.channel_account_ref
columns.comment: Only for channel branches: reference to the channel account (Mercado Libre, Amazon...) that sells on behalf of this branch. One channel account belongs to one channel branch.

columns.name: fulfillment_warehouse_id
columns.label: locations.field.fulfillment_warehouse_id
columns.comment: Where the goods leave from. Defined apart from the entity: the order entity is the branch entity, not the warehouse entity. When they differ the platform flags an intercompany operation.

columns.name: code
columns.label: locations.field.code
columns.comment: Stable identifier, unique per organization. It is the key used to map the entity with an external system; names are never used as keys.

columns.name: legal_name
columns.label: locations.field.legal_name
columns.comment: Legal name (razon social).

columns.name: country
columns.label: locations.field.country
columns.comment: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2. The region addon of that country defines which tax id and regime fields apply.

columns.name: fiscal
columns.label: locations.field.fiscal
columns.comment: Generic tax data: tax_id_type, tax_id, regime, postal_code. The region addon validates it; the core never assumes a country.

columns.name: is_default
columns.label: locations.field.is_default
columns.comment: Exactly one default entity per organization: it takes the branches and records that do not choose one.

columns.name: source
columns.label: locations.field.source
columns.comment: Where the entity is maintained. erp = an external system is the source of truth and Ops shows it read-only.

columns.name: external_system
columns.label: locations.field.external_system
columns.comment: Name of the external system when source is erp (for example 7leguas-v2).

columns.name: external_ref
columns.label: locations.field.external_ref
columns.comment: Id of the entity in the external system.

events.name: locations.branch_created
events.description: DEPRECATED: no live emitter and no subscriber - nothing publishes this event, do not subscribe to it. Was: A branch was created. Published by the host as locations.Branch.created after commit.

events.name: locations.branch_updated
events.description: DEPRECATED: no live emitter and no subscriber - nothing publishes this event, do not subscribe to it. Was: A branch changed. Published by the host as locations.Branch.updated after commit.

events.name: locations.branch_member_created
events.description: DEPRECATED: no live emitter and no subscriber - nothing publishes this event, do not subscribe to it. Was: A user was assigned to a branch. Published by the host as locations.BranchMember.created after commit.

events.name: locations.branch_member_updated
events.description: DEPRECATED: no live emitter and no subscriber - nothing publishes this event, do not subscribe to it. Was: A branch assignment changed (for example, the default branch). Published by the host as locations.BranchMember.updated after commit.

events.name: locations.branch_member_deleted
events.description: DEPRECATED: no live emitter and no subscriber - nothing publishes this event, do not subscribe to it. Was: A user was removed from a branch. Published by the host as locations.BranchMember.deleted after commit.

events.name: locations.entity_created
events.description: A legal entity (razon social) was created. Published by the host as locations.Entity.created after commit.

events.name: locations.entity_updated
events.description: A legal entity changed, including its deactivation. Published by the host as locations.Entity.updated after commit.

events.name: locations.branch_assigned
events.description: A branch was assigned to another legal entity. Published by the host as locations.Branch.updated after commit; the payload carries entity_id and previous_entity_id, so consumers do not rewrite history (issued fiscal documents keep the entity they were issued with).
